notes.title: Solomon Snow: First Contact BIG UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
🚀 Attention Gamers! Spectacular Game Update Alert for Solomon Snow: First Contact! 🎮

We are thrilled to announce the latest and greatest updates to Solomon Snow: First Contact, crafted to enhance your gaming experience spectacularly! Dive into a world of new adventures with improvements and fixes that will elevate your gameplay to a whole new level!

[previewyoutube=759tieBd1cU;full][/previewyoutube]

🌟 Key Highlights of Update 1.2:

New game modes: Casual, Standard, Challenge!

Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics: We've updated the solution file and quality settings for a smoother, more responsive gaming experience.

New Content Additions: Missing files have been added, enriching the game with more content and features.

Build Version Uplifted: The game's build version has been significantly increased, ensuring you're playing the latest, most stable version.

Critical Bug Fixes: Say goodbye to NPCs walking into walls and grenade glitches. These issues have been ironically 'exterminated' to ensure a seamless gaming experience.

Match3 Gameplay Improved: The Match3 feature now always allows for play, enhancing your strategic gaming experience.

NPC and Environmental Tweaks: NPC behaviors and environmental interactions have been refined for a more realistic and engaging experience.

User Interface Improvements: The user interface has been optimized, including better support for different screen ratios and a more intuitive control scheme.

Ammo and Weaponry Updates: Added ammo counters for rifles and alien weapons, ensuring you're always battle-ready.

Loading Screen Enhancements: Fixed and enhanced quotes on the loading screen for an engaging wait time.

Controller Connectivity Enhancements: Xbox players, rejoice! We've fixed the controller disconnected issue at the start for a frustration-free gaming session.

Visual and Audio Adjustments: Numerous visual and audio bugs have been squashed. Enjoy crisper graphics and more immersive sound effects!

New Features and Tweaks: From the addition of new quests to the tweaking of NPC behaviors, we've packed this update with features to keep the game fresh and exciting.

Optimized for Better Performance: Various optimizations have been made across the game to ensure smoother gameplay and better overall performance.

Credits Update: Our hardworking team deserves recognition! We've updated the credits section to include our new team members.

🎉 Get Ready to Experience Solomon Snow Like Never Before!

This update isn't just an improvement; it's a transformation that redefines gaming excitement. So, gear up, jump back into the action of Solomon Snow: First Contact, and prepare for a gaming adventure that's more thrilling than ever!

#SolomonSnowUpdate #GamingEvolution #PlayNow 🌌👾

notes.title: Solomon Snow: First Contact Update 1.2
notes.content:
Attention, Gamers! 🚀🎮

Brace yourselves for the adrenaline-fueled journey in the latest update of Solomon Snow: First Contact: Update 1.2! Just when you thought your day at the office was going to be another routine drill, the unthinkable happens. The Solar System faces an unprecedented threat, and guess where the epicenter is? Yes, your very office!

🌌 New Features:

Game Modes: Casual, Standard, Challenge.

Intricate Office Maze: Find your way through the newly designed, complex labyrinth of corridors. Every corner turns into a strategic point in this battle for survival.

Survivor Rescue Missions: It’s not just about saving your skin anymore. Locate and rescue fellow survivors trapped in the chaos. Each rescue mission adds depth to the storyline and unlocks potential allies.

Enhanced Leadership Roles: Step up as the team leader. Make critical decisions that determine the fate of your crew. Your leadership skills are now more crucial than ever.

Environmental Puzzles: Challenge your intellect with all-new environmental puzzles. These aren't just obstacles; they're opportunities to use the surroundings to your advantage against the alien threat.

Alien Extermination: It's time to get your hands dirty. Engage in intense combat against a variety of alien invaders. Each species comes with its own set of challenges, so strategize accordingly.

🔥 Special Notice:

We've fine-tuned the game mechanics for a more immersive experience. Communication with your team is key. Your decisions and commands can change the course of the battle. So, rally your team, communicate effectively, and remember – the fate of the Solar System rests in your hands.

Are you ready to face the alien onslaught and emerge as the savior of the Solar System? Gear up, soldier. It's time to exterminate the alien scum!

#SolomonSnow #FirstContactUpdate #SaveTheSolarSystem #AlienExtermination

🎮 Solomon Snow: First Contact Update 1.2 available on Steam 15.12.2023 20:30 PM CET on all major gaming platforms. Join the fight and make your mark in the universe! 🌠🛸

For more updates, stay tuned and follow us on [Game News Platform]. Keep gaming, and keep saving the world! 🌍✨

notes.title: New version of Solomon Snow 1.1.20.gd6396297 is available for beta players.
notes.content:
Changelog:
- potential fix for freezing the loading screen
- dissolve effect that appears on killed monsters as a result of dealing critical damage
- increased, better collision for Player bullets (ref to hit box), thanks to which in narrow passages there is no problem with hitting
- collection of dropped items fixed when we no longer have space in the inventory
- fix bake lights on levels 2-4
- removal of tornado attack animation from level 2 - caused problems for players at first had a lot of problems because of that
- monster blaster shooting delay added, it is easier to approach now
- increased movement speed of the player and NPC Friends - it is more dynamic
- improvement of the fast-firing error in certain specific situations, the weapon started firing faster - it may also be a fix for the so-called weapon welding
- adding first aid kits on levels 2, 3 and 4 - beginner players needs them
- fix to increase smoothness on the controller
- better marking of levels, now there is no possibility to mistake start and end of current level
- lighting improvements
- outline monsters, when the player sees them, are displayed for a while
- better explanation of Match3 rules
- IngameMessages for inactive functions such as no grenade etc.
- changing the skill tree - grenade can be obtained from level 6, so players will not make a mistake and buy this skill before they get any grenades
- increasing the power and range of the grenade
- fixes related to strange behavior of monsters - climbing into walls
- fixes in dictionaries
- Game Analytics implementation

notes.title: LIVE STREAM: Solomon Snow - First Contact
notes.content:
Sometimes when you come to work, the Solar System is under attack. Glakmirk battle cruiser has landed on Neptune and portals to the other planets are open, and as Solomon Snow - an ordinary security worker, have to deal with an alien army coming out of the gateway in the Futuresalt Corp.

During the stream, we'll be playing Solomon Snow and trying to get to the last level in the DEMO version. At the same time, we encourage you to actively talk with us :)
